'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Michael Raveling LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3). Sheet title I'm Just Going to Play A deck different.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Senators On The Take|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
